description: Borders and light, not shadows. Resting surfaces are flat and hairline-separated; shadows exist at overlay tiers only.
notes: D6: five tiers, e0 flat, e1 raised, e2 overlay, e3 modal with barrier, e4 system.
Shadow colours are mist-black at low alpha — atmosphere, not drop-shadow graphics.
Dark mode keeps the same tokens and expects them to read as near-invisible: a dark overlay is distinguishable because it is a lighter surface with a lit edge. Never compensate.
Inner shadows are not part of the system.

e1.description: Raised, but by hairline and surface step — not by shadow.
